title: Slice 1: one Spanish Machines on Machines Story, JIT, in preview
description:
As the editor of Machines on Machines, I want one existing Story translated into Spanish by the full JIT procedure, shown at its Spanish address in preview with the welcoming banner, and corrected by one of our Spanish reviewers, so we can judge the whole idea on a real page before anything is public.

Scope: one editor-chosen published MoM Story without text-bearing figures; Spanish; derive from primary; translation procedure steps 1 to 8 (notify goes to the operator list until Caducus subscriptions exist); version model with listing keys, derived ids and alignment on a sandbox backend; preview tool only; countdown banner in preview; one correction through the correction view; measure invalidation paths per publish. No live publish. Plan: docs/plans/multilingual-publishing.md (PR #1450), revised 2026-11-12 with Ryan's decisions.

Feature: Preview one Spanish Story

Scenario: Publishing the English Story generates its Spanish localization
  Given Spanish is configured in preview for Machines on Machines
  When the chosen English Story is published in the sandbox
  Then a Spanish localization is generated, checked and published to preview without anyone assembling it
  And it records the exact English version it came from and the cost of each step

Scenario: The Spanish page in preview
  When the editor opens the preview
  Then the Story is at /es/ with lang es, a translated-by-AI line linking the English page, hreflang for both and a self-canonical link
  And the English page offers the Spanish version with the countdown banner to a Spanish-preferring browser

Scenario: A Spanish reviewer corrects a paragraph
  Given a Spanish reviewer follows the correction link and signs in
  When they reword a paragraph and save
  Then a new Spanish version by that reviewer is published to preview with the paragraph pinned
